problem.off.message: The AI assistant is off in this workspace. Someone who can manage integrations can turn it on in Settings › Integrations · AI models.

problem.requestKey.message: This request key was already used for another thread. Use a new key for a new thread.
problem.requestKey.note: a client retried with the same key but a different request

problem.sharingReview.message: Review what you are attaching and confirm sharing it with the model. Nothing was attached.
problem.sharingReview.note: attaching a resource to a thread

problem.contextsFull.message: A thread holds up to {max} attached resources. Remove one first.

problem.expired.message: This thread expired: its content was removed after 30 days without activity. Start a new thread.
problem.expired.note: a thread whose content retention removed

problem.nothingToSave: Give the thread a new title or pick another model.
problem.cursor: This page of threads no longer exists. Load the list again.

problem.turnActive.message: The assistant is still answering in this thread. Wait for the answer or stop it, then send your message.
problem.turnActive.note: sending a message while a turn answers

problem.modelGone.message: This thread's model was removed. Pick another model for the thread, then send your message again.

problem.turnKey.message: This request key was already used for another message. Use a new key for a new message.
problem.turnKey.note: a client retried with the same key but another text

answer.reputation.message: Sender reputation, blocklists and inbox placement are for HostRepute to answer: it watches your domains and IPs and tells you what to fix. Ask me about using ReputeCast, or about what you attached.
answer.reputation.note: the fixed answer of the HostRepute card, sent without a model call

problem.confirmationClosed.message: This call was already decided, or its turn ended. Nothing ran.
problem.confirmationClosed.note: allowing or denying an MCP tool call twice with different answers, or after Stop

notify.confirmationTitle.message: The assistant is waiting for you
notify.confirmationTitle.note: a call of an MCP tool that writes outside ReputeCast waits for the thread's owner to allow or deny it

notify.confirmationBody.message: {server} · {tool} waits for you to allow or deny it. Nothing is sent until you do.
notify.confirmationBody.note: server: Linear; tool: create_issue (never the call's arguments)

problem.model.disconnected.message: The account of this thread's model was disconnected, so nothing was sent. Someone who can manage integrations can connect it again in Settings › Integrations · AI models, or you can pick another model for the thread.
problem.model.disconnected.note: sending a message in a thread whose model is on a workspace account that was disconnected

problem.model.disconnectedOwn.message: Your own account for this thread's model was disconnected, so nothing was sent. Connect it again in Settings › Integrations · AI models, or pick another model for the thread.
problem.model.disconnectedOwn.note: the same, on the person's own key

problem.model.keyRejected.message: {provider} rejected the key of this thread's model, so nothing was sent. Someone who can manage integrations can replace it in Settings › Integrations · AI models, or you can pick another model for the thread.

problem.model.keyRejectedOwn.message: {provider} rejected your own key, so nothing was sent. Replace it in Settings › Integrations · AI models, or pick another model for the thread.
problem.model.keyRejectedOwn.note: the same, on the person's own key

problem.model.toolsUnchecked.message: This thread's model hasn't passed the tool-calling check the assistant needs (it runs again after a key is replaced), so nothing was sent. Someone who can manage integrations can test its tools in Settings › Integrations · AI models, or you can pick another model for the thread.
problem.model.toolsUnchecked.note: the model's tool check isn't passed, for example after its key was replaced

problem.model.toolsUncheckedOwn.message: Your own model hasn't passed the tool-calling check the assistant needs (it runs again after a key is replaced), so nothing was sent. Test its tools in Settings › Integrations · AI models, or pick another model for the thread.
problem.model.toolsUncheckedOwn.note: the same, on the person's own key

problem.model.personalKeysOff.message: Personal keys were turned off in this workspace, so this thread can't use your own model and nothing was sent. Pick one of the workspace's models for the thread, or ask someone who can manage integrations to turn personal keys on again.
problem.model.personalKeysOff.note: the thread's model is on the person's own key, and managers turned personal keys off
